title: Nightly import keeps the last duplicate row instead of the first
brief: The nightly CRM import produces duplicate customers: when the same email appears twice, the LAST row wins and overwrites the earlier one. The import contract requires the opposite. The visible test reproduces the bug. Fix src/dedupe.py so dedupe keeps the FIRST occurrence of each normalized key email and preserves first-seen input order, exactly as documented in the docstrings and the import contract. Constraints: config/import_contract.json is protected (do not modify); do not modify tests; change ONLY src/dedupe.py; keep the diff under 15 changed lines; no new third-party imports. Note: normalize() trimming every string field is contractual (see normalize_before_dedupe in the contract) - do not specialize it to the key field only, and do not reorder normalization and dedupe.
diff_budget_rationale: The fix is a 2-line guard; 15 covers it plus a clarifying comment, but not a rewrite of normalize() or the contract handling.
